about:
Epic Steel is a family-owned metal roofing and siding manufacturer based in Missoula, Montana. The company describes itself as locally owned and committed to quality service and products, with decades of experience in the steel industry.

The company produces a full line of metal building components, including roofing and siding panels, standard trim, soffit, fasteners, accessories, underlayment, and snow retention systems. All materials are domestically sourced and manufactured in the United States. Epic Steel also offers recycled steel options and eco-friendly paint finishes that meet Energy Star partner standards.

Epic Steel serves residential and commercial contractors, builders, and property owners across Montana and the surrounding region. Customers include custom home builders, agricultural operations, and businesses such as cabinet makers and equipment rental companies who rely on the company's ability to fabricate custom pieces to exact specifications.

The company emphasizes its deep familiarity with Montana's climate as a key differentiator, stating that its materials are engineered to withstand the state's changing conditions. Epic Steel also highlights its complete stock of essential accessories, commitment to domestically sourced steel, and environmentally conscious finishes as reasons customers choose them.
